name: MoE Run Anyway Expert Paging Roadmap

current_truth_table.can_do: Export run-scoped model, backend, endpoint, log, observability, and safety hints for MoE planning.
current_truth_table.cannot_do: Expose semantic expert ids unless the runtime exposes router outputs.

current_truth_table.can_do: Validate expert inventory, routing visibility, residency states, policy decisions, backend adapter boundaries, fallback, cleanup, and memory-moe-bridge-v1 artifact expectations.
current_truth_table.cannot_do: Read or mutate live expert residency; the runtime actuator is still missing.

current_truth_table.can_do: Plan dry-run and preflight-only baseline commands for llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama, or OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
current_truth_table.cannot_do: Launch servers, send prompt traffic, or page experts.

current_truth_table.can_do: Validate Phase 1 baseline artifact classes and label runtime evidence separately from semantic routing evidence.
current_truth_table.cannot_do: Collect live runtime artifacts or prove semantic expert ids from stock endpoint telemetry.

current_truth_table.can_do: Capture request-boundary telemetry and upstream observability without invasive runtime changes.
current_truth_table.cannot_do: Alter expert residency or infer semantic routing from endpoint timing alone.

current_truth_table.can_do: Capture router outputs and semantic expert ids when Python modules expose them.
current_truth_table.cannot_do: Apply to stock llama.cpp GGUF execution.

current_truth_table.can_do: Score offline residency policies over synthetic or captured traces.
current_truth_table.cannot_do: Pin, evict, preload, or load only routed experts in a live backend.
No live expert loading, eviction, pinning, preloading, or expert offload override exists.

phases.title: Harness contract and Model Plane handoff
deliverables: Roadmap document and machine-readable checklist.
Managed expert loading contract defines inventory, routing visibility, residency state, policy decision, backend adapter, fallback, cleanup, and artifact requirements.
Manifest planner remains planning-only and emits a planned harness_run_request stage.
Saved Model Plane runtime-baseline manifest fixture exercises the handoff planner.
Model Plane callable-function and cron handoff is documented.
Actuator spike proof checklist is tracked.
evidence_gates: Roadmap JSON validates with scripts/plan_expert_paging.py.
Managed expert loading JSON validates with scripts/plan_managed_expert_loading.py.
Manifest planner output names the planned harness_run_request without executing it when run against memory-moe-mvp/data/model_plane_moe_probe_manifest.runtime_baseline.fixture.json with --json.
Dependency-free tests cover planner output and roadmap validation.
next_actions: Preserve the saved manifest fixture as the local Phase 0 handoff gate.
Keep all probe execution behind explicit user approval.

phases.title: Artifact evidence from runtime baselines
deliverables: Runtime baseline artifact contract that separates runtime evidence from semantic routing evidence.
llama.cpp runtime baseline artifact bundle.
vLLM or OpenAI-compatible runtime baseline artifact bundle.
Backend labels mapped to memory-moe-bridge-v1 fields.
Managed-loading capability labels for inventory, routing visibility, residency read/write, fallback, artifact export, and cleanup.
Explicit separation of runtime evidence from semantic routing evidence.
evidence_gates: Runtime baseline artifact contract validates with scripts/plan_runtime_baseline_artifacts.py.
At least one run-scoped artifact bundle exists for each selected backend class.
Artifacts include timing, readiness, observability, manifest metadata, and safety notes.
No artifact claims semantic expert ids unless router outputs are exposed.
next_actions: Use Model Plane cron or callable functions to export manifests for approved runtime baselines.
Run only dry-run or preflight-only planning until the user approves prompt traffic.
Compare artifact fields across llama.cpp and OpenAI-compatible baselines.

phases.title: Hookable PyTorch semantic routing trace runner
deliverables: Local hookable trace runner for a PyTorch/Transformers-style MoE.
Router output capture for layer, expert id, score or probability, entropy, prompt family, and token/window metadata.
Trace artifacts compatible with controller replay.
evidence_gates: Semantic traces validate under memory-moe-bridge-v1.
Dense fallback output can be recorded or compared for the same prompt set.
Hooking failures are explicit and never downgraded into timing inference.
next_actions: Select a local hookable MoE runtime only when dependencies and weights are already available.
Extend forward-hook tests with fixture-level semantic trace validation.

phases.title: Managed loading policy and replay audit with dense fallback comparison
deliverables: Replay controller evaluates candidate residency policies over semantic traces.
Dense fallback comparison is part of the audit contract.
Policy output uses the managed-loading vocabulary: observe_only, preload, pin, keep, evict, demote, fallback_dense, abort_run, and confidence fields.
evidence_gates: Policy decisions are reproducible from artifacts.
Warm-hit or memory benefit is shown without unacceptable churn.
Dense fallback bounds behavior or quality drift.
next_actions: Add replay fixtures from Phase 2 semantic traces.
Report churn, fallback rate, missed experts, and dense-baseline deltas.

phases.title: Managed expert loading backend adapter feasibility spike
deliverables: Spike plan identifying backend-specific control points for llama.cpp first, then vllm_openai_compatible, hookable_pytorch, moe_infinity_style, or prototype_offload_system adapters as evidence permits.
Comparison of outside controller, small llama.cpp patch, fork, backend plugin, and hookable runtime adapter options.
Proof checklist for routing visibility, residency control, dense fallback, artifact shape, cleanup, and rollback.
evidence_gates: A concrete runtime hook, adapter, or patch point can read and influence expert residency or offload behavior.
The runtime can emit auditable artifacts without breaking dense baseline execution.
Cleanup and fallback are tested under failure.
next_actions: Audit llama.cpp MoE loading/offload paths before writing a patch.
Prefer a small controller patch or fork over a custom runtime if llama.cpp is viable.

phases.title: Guarded runtime actuator experiment
deliverables: Guarded actuator mode for preload, pin, evict, or expert residency restriction.
Kill switch, dense fallback, artifact export, and cleanup.
Automatic comparison against baseline and replay expectations.
evidence_gates: Actuator behavior is externally observable and internally auditable.
Dense fallback remains available for every run.
A measurable memory or latency effect is shown without unacceptable regression.
next_actions: Run only after Phase 4 proves a safe actuator point.
Keep the first experiment narrow, reversible, and artifact-first.

decision_gates.requires: Manifest, roadmap, managed-loading contract, and planner checks pass locally.
Runtime baselines establish artifact shape and explicit limits.
Semantic traces exist from a hookable runtime.
Replay policies use managed-loading decision vocabulary and show useful behavior against dense fallback comparisons.
A backend adapter or runtime actuator point exists, can read/write residency state, and has a rollback plan.

managed_expert_loading.role: Concrete contract layer between roadmap-only expert paging and a future live runtime actuator.
managed_expert_loading.current_limit: Planning and validation only; no live expert residency mutation exists.

llama_cpp_options.can_do: Schedule runs, choose probe suites, analyze artifacts, and recommend residency.
llama_cpp_options.cannot_do: Load only routed experts or alter tensor residency without runtime support.

llama_cpp_options.can_do: Expose routing and residency controls if llama.cpp internals support a narrow patch.
llama_cpp_options.cannot_do: Avoid maintenance cost; must be justified by Phase 1-3 evidence.
Stay scoped; this is a last resort, not the starting point.

model_plane_handoff.source: Model Plane callable function or cron
model_plane_handoff.contract: MoE consumes manifests and emits planning artifacts; Model Plane owns orchestration surfaces.
safety: No model launch from roadmap/planner checks.
No downloads, authentication, Docker, or prompt traffic from roadmap/planner checks.
Probe execution requires explicit user approval.

actuator_spike_checklist.question: Can the runtime expose routed expert ids or sufficient router metadata at the decision point?
actuator_spike_checklist.required_evidence: Artifact showing layer, token or window, expert id, and routing score or rank.

actuator_spike_checklist.question: Can policy pin, evict, preload, or alter expert offload behavior?
actuator_spike_checklist.required_evidence: Runtime proof that residency changes occur and are visible.

actuator_spike_checklist.question: Can the run revert to normal dense/full-residency behavior?
actuator_spike_checklist.required_evidence: Fallback command or mode plus comparable artifact.

actuator_spike_checklist.question: Can decisions and outcomes be exported in memory-moe-bridge-v1-compatible form?
actuator_spike_checklist.required_evidence: Validated artifact with policy decision and observed outcome fields.

actuator_spike_checklist.question: Does interruption or failure restore runtime state?
actuator_spike_checklist.required_evidence: Failure-path cleanup test or rollback artifact.

risks: Endpoint metrics may be overinterpreted as semantic routing.
A runtime patch may expose routing but not safe tensor residency control.
Replay policies may cause live churn or cleanup failures.
Backend artifact fields may drift without strict labels.
Fork maintenance cost may exceed the benefit if the patch is not small.
non_goals: Claim live expert paging before an actuator exists.
Download models, use tokens, run Docker, launch model servers, or send prompt traffic from roadmap/planner checks.
Start with a large custom runtime rewrite.
Infer semantic expert ids from stock OpenAI-compatible endpoint telemetry.
Perform destructive cleanup or mutate user model caches.
